missing.description: Exactly what is missing, e.g. 'at least 90 days of sales'
missing.title: Missing

impact.description: Effect, e.g. gap reduced by Tk X

AnchorReceipt.description: Proof that a digest was anchored. Only a SHA-256 hex digest ever goes on chain.
AnchorReceipt.title: AnchorReceipt

ApiError.description: Error body returned by every endpoint. `message_key` is an i18n key.
ApiError.title: ApiError

AuditEvent.description: One link of the append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained audit log.
AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

Bill.description: Money the business owes a supplier.
Bill.title: Bill

DataMode.description: Where data came from. Shown to users; synthetic data is always labelled.
DataMode.title: DataMode

DraftRow.description: An OCR'd or uncertain row the owner must confirm before it is committed.
DraftRow.title: DraftRow

verified.description: True when checked against its source, not self-declared
verified.title: Verified

masked.description: True if source rows were masked for the caller's role
masked.title: Masked

provenance.description: None only for raw facts read straight from a source row

Figure.description: A number shown to a user. Always computed by code, always explainable.
Figure.title: Figure

effective_apr.description: True annual cost in percent, fees included
effective_apr.title: Effective Apr

is_modelled.description: True for illustrative products (e.g. the P14 China pack)
is_modelled.title: Is Modelled

nominal_rate_pa.description: Percent per year as published, e.g. 9
nominal_rate_pa.title: Nominal Rate Pa

Invoice.description: Money a customer owes the business (includes baki / credit sales).
Invoice.title: Invoice

quoted_vs_realised_apr_gap.description: Average realised minus quoted APR, percentage points
quoted_vs_realised_apr_gap.title: Quoted Vs Realised Apr Gap

MeshObligation.description: `debtor_tenant` owes `creditor_tenant`. Both are Hishab tenants that opted in.
MeshObligation.title: MeshObligation

approvals.description: tenant -> approved?; missing = not answered yet
approvals.title: Approvals

display_label.description: Neutral label safe to show anywhere, e.g. 'Customer 3'
display_label.title: Display Label

is_tenant.description: True if this party is itself a Hishab tenant (mesh peer)
is_tenant.title: Is Tenant

price.description: Mid price; low/high when the source gives a range

parameters.description: Non-fact inputs such as seed or horizon, as strings
parameters.title: Parameters

RateBasis.description: How we know the rate. Shown next to every rate in the UI.
RateBasis.title: RateBasis

value.description: None when the denominator is zero or missing
value.title: Value

ShareGrant.description: Consented, scoped, expiring access for one lender.
ShareGrant.title: ShareGrant

score.description: Share of variations where the choice held
score.title: Score

Tier.description: Permission tier of an action (FEATURES P2).
Tier.title: Tier

on_time_rate.description: Share of past orders delivered on time (SME's own history)
on_time_rate.title: On Time Rate
